events.title: U.S. Trade Deficit Widens To Seventeen-Month High In August
events.description: A report released by the Commerce Department on Tuesday showed the U.S. trade deficit widened by more than expected in the month of August. The Commerce Department said the trade deficit increased to $105.6 billion in August from a revised $92.8 billion in July.

events.title: German Factory Orders Plunge
events.description: Germany's factory orders declined sharply in August largely due to the fall in demand for aircraft, ships, trains and military vehicles, official data revealed Tuesday. Factory orders plunged 10.6 percent from the previous month, in contrast to the 3.2 percent rise in July, Destatis reported. Orders were forecast to decrease moderately by 0.9 percent.

events.title: Canadian Stocks Poised For Positive Open Amid Easing Oil Prices
events.description: Higher Canadian and U.S. futures, declining oil prices, and lower global bond yields suggest a positive market open on Bay Street Tuesday. West Texas Intermediate Crude fell 2.63% to $87.08 per barrel, while gold and silver futures gained.

events.title: U.S. Trade Deficit Widens More Than Expected In August
events.description: A report released by the Commerce Department on Tuesday showed the U.S. trade deficit widened by more than expected in the month of August.

events.title: Euro Rises Amid Risk-on Mood
events.description: The euro strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday, as European stocks traded higher as Brent crude prices dipped below $100 a barrel on signs of resilient Middle Eastern crude exports and Euro zone bond yields fell, helping reduce the spread between French and German 10-year yields.

events.title: UK Construction Activity Shrinks At Slower Pace
events.description: The UK construction sector shrank at the slowest pace in eight months in September, survey data from S&P Global showed Tuesday. The construction Purchasing Managers' Index rose to 46.1 in September from 44.3 in August. However, a score below 50.0 indicates contraction.

events.title: FTSE 100 Extends Recent Gains
events.description: The U.K. stock market gained ground in positive territory on Tuesday, extending recent gains, as declining oil prices and lower global bond yields lifted sentiment.

events.title: CAC 40 Firmly In Positive Territory As Bond Yields, Oil Prices Drop
events.description: French stocks climbed notably higher on Tuesday, rebounding from previous session's losses, despite lingering concerns over the nation's fiscal woes and political uncertainty. Lower oil prices and bond yields helped lift sentiment.

events.title: Indian Shares Extend Gains For Second Day As Oil Prices Retreat
events.description: Indian shares rallied on Tuesday, extending gains from the previous session amid diminished expectations for another Federal Reserve interest-rate hike in October.

events.title: Euro Rises Against Majors
events.description: The euro strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday.

events.title: Gold Edges Higher As Oil Prices And Bond Yields Dip
events.description: Gold prices were modestly higher on Tuesday as falling oil prices and lower bond yields helped ease concerns around inflation and interest rates.

events.title: Oil Prices Slide As Middle East Oil Exports Recover
events.description: Oil prices were sharply lower on Tuesday, with Brent crude prices dipping below $100 a barrel on signs of resilient Middle Eastern crude exports and the G7's announcement to launch a 100-million-barrel coordinated stock release.

events.title: DAX Moves Higher As Lower Oil Prices, Bond Yields Offset Weak Economic Data
events.description: Despite weak factory orders and construction sector data, the German market gained significant ground in positive territory Tuesday morning thanks to a sharp drop in crude oil prices and lower Euro zone bond yields. Factory orders plunged 10.6% in August.
